candidates.description: This vector activates on Thai script characters and diacritics.
This vector activates on common medical and scientific suffixes, word roots, and mixed-script morphological fragments.
These tokens represent common prefixes and combining forms used in scientific and technical terminology.
This feature represents a mix of multilingual text fragments, technical abbreviations, and common subword tokens without a unified semantic theme.
These tokens represent the concept of categories, types, styles, or systems across different languages (predominantly Thai and some fragments).
This vector represents characters, diacritics, and sub-word tokens of the Thai writing system.
This vector activates strongly on mixed-script proper nouns, names, and loanwords, particularly in French and Thai.
This feature vector detects multilingual text fragments and sub-word tokens containing the sequence "wh" or its phonetic equivalents.
This feature vector activates strongly on biological and genetic terminology, particularly terms related to nucleic acids and lipids.
This feature vector represents terms associated with the prefix, abbreviation, or concept related to "Gram" (such as Gram stain, tuberculosis/TB, and related linguistic or scientific tokens).
